Definition
[Distributional Laplacian inequality] ↗ def:riemannian-metric

Fix an additive Haar normalization for the volume measure of a Riemannian manifold $(M,g)$. For a locally Lipschitz function $f$ and a locally integrable function $h$, write $\triangle f\le h$ in the distributional (weak) sense when, for every non-negative compactly supported smooth test function $\phi $, \[ \int _M f\triangle \phi \, d\vol _g\le \int _M h\phi \, d\vol _g. \]
